reason: The free hour I would take, because he says he will tell me to change a process or use software I already pay for instead of selling me something, that is not how a guy selling a $3,000 job talks. objection: My whole fear is a robot answering my phone and quoting a job wrong to a customer who has been with me eight years. He talks about process and software, not about what happens when it fumbles a call, and I do not know him from Adam out of Roscoe.
would_change_my_mind: The free look actually tells me something I do not already know, and he will put me on the phone with an owner my size who used him and will say what broke.
